description: Default permissions plus the webview-window creation surface the pop-out buttons need (terminal drawer in chat → term-*; artifact detail → art-*). The globs cover every spawned window without needing per-id capability entries. The http:default allow-list intentionally accepts any HTTP/HTTPS URL — HT is a trusted-LAN product and the cluster surface keeps growing (search.ht.local, images.ht.local, ai.ht.local, NodePort services, Tailscale 100/8 peers, etc.). Narrow per-host allow-lists shaped wrong against the URL Pattern parser have caused 'Command plugin:http|fetch not allowed by ACL' surprises; broad allow + trusted-LAN deployment is the right trade.
